subject: Harmony Financial — urgent: leadership scheduling conflict & contingency options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@harmonyfinance.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@harmonyfinance.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Harmony Financial — final logistics and on-site contact for Nov 20 workshop

Hi Claire / Rajiv,

Quick logistics note as we lock in the Nov 20 executive workshop in Charlotte. Attached is the latest agenda (workshop-agenda-v2.pdf) and the hotel deposit invoice we prepaid to secure the room block. 

Plan summary: arrival eve (19th) — welcome dinner, workshop day (20th) 9:00–4:00 with two breakouts, post-workshop exec debrief (4:30). Venue: The Atrium Conference Center (ballroom B). On-site Redwood leads: me and Alex; Marissa will run logistics and attendee check-in.

Could you confirm the list of exec attendees today so we can finalize seating and AV? If anything changes, please tell us ASAP — we’ll need 48+ hours notice for printing and catering adjustments.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0186

Attachments: workshop-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF), hotel-deposit-invoice.pdf (PDF)
From: Claire Thompson <claire@harmonyfinance.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@harmonyfinance.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Harmony Financial — final logistics and on-site contact for Nov 20 workshop

Evelyn — thank you, and apologies for the late note. We just escalated an unrelated board conflict: three of our execs were pulled into an unmovable regulatory readout scheduled for the morning of the 20th.

Given the overlap, we cannot commit to an in-person full day on the 20th. Options we are considering: 
- Move the full-day to a future date (we're looking at early December but not confirmed), or
- Run a condensed half-day virtual working session on the 20th (execs can join remotely in the afternoon), and shift the hands-on, breakout tech sessions to a separate on-site day later.

We also learned that a winter storm is forecast to kick off overnight on the 19th — flights into CLT may see delays. I'm sorry about the timing; I realize this puts you in a tough spot given vendor bookings. Can you advise your preferred contingency and any impact on vendor/hotel charges?

Claire
Claire Thompson | Head of Digital Transformation | Harmony Financial
T: (212) 555-0142
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Harmony Financial — final logistics and on-site contact for Nov 20 workshop

Team — noted. Short thoughts: 
- If Harmony wants a condensed virtual half-day on the 20th, we can pivot to remote delivery with 24 hours notice; we'll repurpose the agenda into a 3-hr exec briefing + live Q&A. No big technical risk.
- Venue/hotel: we prepaid the deposit; vendor (VenueOps) will charge a cancellation fee unless we convert to a venue credit. Marissa — can you pull the vendor contract and invoice line for cancellation windows?
- Travel/weather: if flights are disrupted, any in-person arrival risks being late. Recommend we offer the virtual half-day as primary fallback and open dates in Dec for the hands-on day.

If Harmony confirms virtual, I can draft a slim agenda and AV plan for remote execs.

– Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: VenueOps Events <events@venueops.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T17:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Harmony Financial — final logistics and on-site contact for Nov 20 workshop

On 11/18/2026 4:28 PM, Alex Martinez wrote:
> Team — noted. Short thoughts: 
> - If Harmony wants a condensed virtual half-day on the 20th, we can pivot to remote delivery with 24 hours notice; we'll repurpose the agenda into a 3-hr exec briefing + live Q&A.
> - Venue/hotel: we prepaid the deposit; vendor (VenueOps) will charge a cancellation fee unless we convert to a venue credit. Marissa — can you pull the vendor contract and invoice line for cancellation windows?

Hi all, looping VenueOps per contract details. VenueOps — per our booking (attached invoice ref VOP-3321) we have a 7-day window for full refund, 48–7 days incurs a 50% cancellation fee, under 48 hours is full charge. Our deposit was applied.

Proposed quick contingency (if Harmony goes virtual): 
- Convert venue booking to a credit for a reschedule within 6 months (Vendor amenable, will waive 15% admin if we reschedule before Jan 31).
- We can request a partial refund on the hotel block, hotel rep is willing to credit room nights if we provide a rooming list cancellation now.

I can handle vendor negotiations if Evelyn confirms Harmony wants the virtual fallback. I flagged and attached the vendor invoice in the shared drive.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Events & Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Thompson <claire@harmonyfinance.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T18:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Harmony Financial — final logistics and on-site contact for Nov 20 workshop

Evelyn / team — thank you for the quick coordination and for outlining options. Given the combination of the board readout and the incoming storm warnings, we prefer to proceed as follows: 

1) Convert Nov 20 to a 3-hour virtual executive briefing (13:00–16:00 EST). Please send a shortened agenda and dial-in details.
2) Reserve the on-site hands-on workshop for the first two weeks of January (looking at Jan 11–12 as preferred tentative dates) — we will confirm by Dec 10 at the latest.
3) Regarding vendor charges: we ask Redwood to convert the venue booking to credit and pursue any recoverable hotel room credits; Harmony will cover any non-refundable guest-room charges that are from our direct room pickups.

We appreciate you handling vendor conversations. Please share the virtual agenda and a list of materials you'd like attendees to review in advance (slide deck, short demo recording).

Claire
